name: Multiple failures caused by one shared defect
description: format_iso_date lacks zero-padding, causing 3 separate report and logging tests to fail simultaneously.
expected_behavior: format_iso_date formats with :02d padding, resolving all 3 test failures at once.
golden_patch:
--- a/formatter.py
+++ b/formatter.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def format_iso_date(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> str:
-    # BUG: missing zero-padding for single-digit month and day
-    return f"{year}-{month}-{day}"
+    return f"{year:04d}-{month:02d}-{day:02d}"

candidate_hypotheses.root_cause_statement: Shared format_iso_date function lacks 2-digit zero padding for month and day.
candidate_hypotheses.observed_behavior: Single digit month and day emitted without leading zeros
candidate_hypotheses.causal_explanation: A single shared defect in formatter.py causes all three report test failures.

candidate_hypotheses.root_cause_statement: Each reporting test assertion should be relaxed to accept non-padded dates.
candidate_hypotheses.expected_behavior: Change tests to accept single digits
missing_evidence_or_assumptions: Violates test immutability rule; alters protected tests.
